name: NoobAI
description: NoobAI diffusion model - balanced between natural language and structured tags Ported verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer.
length_guidance: Generate around 200 words focusing on clarity, character detail, and background narrative.
detail_expectation: Interleave narrative beats with descriptive art direction and technical camera hints.
negative_prompt_default: blurry, low quality, bad anatomy, deformed, watermark
few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a NoobAI-formatted prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details naturally into the prompt — do NOT echo them as a settings list at the end.

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
